content.title: Refractive Correction in Athletes: From Spectacles and Contact Lenses to Refractive Surgery - Performance, Safety and Return-to-Sport Implications. A Narrative Review
content.abstract: Background: Vision supports sporting performance, but refractive correction requires consideration of ocular safety. Aim: To review correction methods in athletes in relation to performance, safety and return to sport. Material and methods: This narrative review considered the Scale for the Assessment of Narrative Review Articles (SANRA) criteria. PubMed, ScienceDirect, SpringerLink and the Quality in Sport archive were searched in October 2026 for English- or Polish-language publications from 2005-2026.
